newsitem.title: USA: MascoTech in talks on European acquisition.
newsitem.headline: MascoTech in talks on European acquisition.

text.p: MascoTech Inc said Monday it is engaged in advanced discussions with a European forging company for the acquisition of certain of its operations.
The business that may be acquired has annual sales in excess of $100 million, MascoTech said.
The company said if the deal is completed, it would significantly expand MascoTech's European operations and would provide future growth opportunities.

Any transaction would be subject to due diligence, the execution of a definitive agreement, regulatory approvals and approval by each company's board of directors and would not likely be completed until late 1997, MascoTech said.
The company said Monday that its chairman and chief executive officer, Richard Manoogian, made comments about the talks to an investor conference.
